responsibility: Defines the processor-specific scheduling description for the S/390 z17 CPU in GCC’s machine-description scheduler. Like the neighboring z13–z16 scheduler files, it classifies S/390 instruction mnemonics into z17 functional-unit groups such as FXA, FXB, FXD, LSU, VFU, and FPD, then assigns per-mnemonic reservation/latency buckets through define_insn_reservation entries for cpu="z17". GCC uses this file when tuning generated RTL for z17 so its instruction scheduler and cost modeling reflect z17 execution resources and timing for scalar, vector, floating-point, decimal, memory, and transactional instructions.
